canonicalFacts.claim: Atopic dermatitis affects approximately 10% of adults and 20% of children globally
Dupilumab has dramatically improved outcomes for adults with severe atopic dermatitis since becoming available in 2016
Atopic dermatitis is caused by complex interaction of immune dysregulation, epidermal gene mutations, and environmental factors disrupting the epidermis
Different phenotypes of atopic dermatitis are defined by patient age at onset, race, ethnic background, disease duration, and other characteristics
Dupilumab treatment is associated with increased frequency of ocular adverse effects in clinical practice

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Liberal use of emollients as maintenance therapy
Avoid environmental triggers that disrupt the epidermal barrier

redFlags: JAK inhibitors carry FDA boxed warning for cardiovascular events and venous thromboembolism
Dupilumab may cause unpredictable ocular adverse effects requiring ophthalmologic monitoring
